post.text:
The “ban data centers” crowd is totally unserious, it’s more wishful thinking than a policy plan

They have to go somewhere, AI, cloud, etc are not simply going to go away

Instead, let’s cheer on stuff like this: https://t.co/7KvNU0F5lk
